title: Energy & Utilities
meta_description: Dataq Software programs for Energy & Utilities: priority use cases, regulatory posture and delivery model.

blocks.x: What Energy & Utilities means at Dataq Software: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per feeder outcomes measured against your audited baseline.

The energy transition rewires the operating model: distributed renewables make supply stochastic, demand flexibility becomes an asset class, and the grid's control philosophy shifts from dispatchable certainty to probabilistic orchestration. Every actor in the value chain — generation, TSO/DSO, retail, trading, oil & gas — now competes on how fast it can turn telemetry into decisions and decisions into money.

blocks.x: The complexity is physics plus markets plus regulation: NERC CIP and IEC 61850/62443 govern the operational estate, REMIT/MiFID shape trading conduct, DORA reaches grid operators, and sustainability reporting (CSRD) makes emissions data auditable. Meanwhile post-quantum timelines loom over infrastructure whose secrets must outlive careers. Getting this stack wrong is not a P&L event; it is a blackout or a sanction.
